query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS competitor_products (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  manufacturer TEXT NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(255),
  category VARCHAR(255),
  domain_id VARCHAR(36),
  marketing_claims JSON,
  technical_data_sheet TEXT,
  msds_data TEXT,
  observed_properties JSON,
  extracted_parameters JSON,
  suggested_formulation_strategy TEXT,
  target_product_profile JSON,
  confidence_score DECIMAL(5,2),
  analysis_status ENUM('pending', 'analyzing', 'completed', 'failed') DEFAULT 'pending',
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (domain_id) REFERENCES domains(id),
  INDEX idx_competitor_products_org (organization_id),
  INDEX idx_competitor_products_domain (domain_id)
);
